label: Empty input set
description: Transaction spends nothing — the input set is empty.

label: Reference input overlaps a spent input
description: A UTxO appears as both a spent input and a reference input.

label: Network id mismatch
description: Body network id is testnet while the output addresses are mainnet.

label: Auxiliary-data hash without metadata
description: Body carries an auxiliary-data hash but the transaction has no metadata.

label: Metadata without auxiliary-data hash
description: Transaction has metadata but the body omits its auxiliary-data hash.
